snippet.title: Chicken Show Teaser - En
snippet.description: Chick’Hen Show is an adventure game for 2 to 4 players in which chickens compete against each other on a completely crazy TV show. Hosted by an eccentric presenter, players must cooperate to progress through the show while trying to become the grand prize winner!
